nodes.rationale: Attachment bytes stripped from session history after turn to prevent 20x re-billing across 10-turn window.

nodes.label: Byte Cap as Duration Proxy
nodes.rationale: Enforcing true duration requires ffprobe and decoding, consuming memory to measure; byte cap is the enforceable proxy protecting the host.

nodes.label: Container Memory Cap Correction
nodes.rationale: Container was capped at 512 MB (not 8 GB host); raised to 1 GB mem_limit with memswap_limit 1 GB to disable SD card paging.

nodes.label: Flash-Lite Modality Verification
nodes.rationale: Verified gemini-3.5-flash-lite supports text, image, video, audio, and PDF natively with 1M input window; no model switch needed.

nodes.label: Inline Data vs Files API Decision
nodes.norm_label: inline data vs files api decision
nodes.rationale: Use inlineData under 20 MB ceiling; excludes Files API to avoid upload round trips, storage lifetime management, and extra hot-path failure modes.

nodes.label: Recommended Attachment Caps
nodes.rationale: Caps: 10 MB PDF (latency-bound), 8 MB audio (~5 min), 10 MB low-res video (~60s), 32 MB total in-flight across channels.

nodes.label: 4.7x RSS Attachment Multiplier
nodes.rationale: Attachment payload is copied 4 times (arrayBuffer 1x, Buffer.from 1x, base64 1.33x, JSON 1.33x) totaling 4.66x RSS overhead.

nodes.label: Streaming Size Guard
nodes.rationale: Running byte counter cancels reader mid-transfer to protect against missing Content-Length headers buffering full video in memory.

nodes.label: SD Card Swap Thrashing Resolution
nodes.rationale: Setting memswap_limit equal to mem_limit disables SD card swap paging, preventing 63s turnDeadlineMs timeouts and SD wear.

nodes.label: Upload Latency Bounds
nodes.rationale: At measured 2.5 MB/s uplink, 10 MB takes 4.0s (fits 20s attempt with 6s spare), while 20 MB leaves zero retry headroom in 63s turnDeadlineMs.

nodes.label: V8 Heap Limit Bypass by Buffers
nodes.norm_label: v8 heap limit bypass by buffers
nodes.rationale: Node.js Buffers live outside V8 heap (259MB/560MB limits), allocating container RSS directly so kernel OOM kills before JS OOM throws.

nodes.label: Video Default Resolution Declined
nodes.rationale: Declined: 300 tokens/sec exhausts 250K TPM in 10 one-minute clips, costing 3x low resolution for zero benefit at small sizes.
